name: Imodane
description: A raiding knight who pledged fealty to Will.

description_citations.text: "Will Kenrith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan meet the rebel knight Imodane, who calls herself queen and mocks Will as pathetic.
timeline.quote: "The only reason I agreed to this little meeting was to see if you were as pathetic as I'd heard."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will proposes a duel: if Imodane loses she kneels; if she wins Will will surrender the crown of Eldraine to her.
timeline.quote: "I'll surrender the crown of Eldraine. You will be High Queen in name and deed."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will freezes the ground and Imodane slips, but she melts the ice and knocks Will to the ground with her hammer.
timeline.quote: Flame bursts from the head of her hammer.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: As Imodane raises her hammer over Will, Rowan unleashes a huge lightning bolt that splits the mountainside.
timeline.quote: Rowan's cut a massive rift into the side of the nearest peak.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Terrified, Imodane drops her hammer and flees into the woods, while Will stares at Rowan in fear.
timeline.quote: Imodane drops the hammer, turns tail, and runs.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Imodane stumbles through the woods into the throne room of the Faerie Lord, who says she was summoned and asks if she is pure of heart.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will's knights burst into Ardenvale as Eriette strains to control sleepers and Rowan blasts the floor before Imodane.
timeline.quote: All of this energy she unleashes in a fearsome bolt aimed at Imodane's feet.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok returns and takes control of the sleepers, turning the battle against Will's knights.
timeline.quote: Veils of black coalesce into Ashiok's elegant form before the gathered army.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: During Will's duel with Imodane, Rowan cuts a rift into a mountain, naming Stormcutter Mountain.
timeline.quote: Rowan cut a massive rift into a nearby mountain

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will wins Imodane's fealty, assaults Castle Ardenvale, defeats Ashiok with Kellan and Ruby, and captures Eriette, ending the Wicked Slumber; Rowan escapes into the Wilds.
timeline.quote: capture the witch Eriette , ending the Wicked Slumber.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Will seeks to make Imodane kneel
relations.quote: If I give you reason to think otherwise, you bend the knee.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

pages_say.description: A scarred knight with a wooden arm and a hammer who demands tribute and styles herself queen, and who is summoned by the Faerie Lord.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

pages_say.description: A knight who once tried to cross Hylda's drawbridge before coming to Edgewall.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

pages_say.description: A wooden-armed knight now fighting for Will, who rejoins the battle against Rowan.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.
